name: Rilli Greasygob
summary: In Orgrimmar, Rilli Greasygob is the specialist Wenikee Boltbucket seeks. She sends you there with a damaged samophlange, hoping his knowledge of its Venture Company origins can explain the device.

sections.title: When Tinkering Fails
sections.body: Wenikee Boltbucket examined the samophlange recovered from the Venture Company drilling site in the Barrens. Her extra gauges showed the apparatus nearing collapse. More levers and dials might destroy it, so she stopped and sent the problem to someone with knowledge of its design.

sections.title: A Former Company Man
sections.body: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, Wenikee sends you to Nogg's Machine Shop. Rilli Greasygob works there as an engineer and once learned his trade within the Venture Company. He recognizes the machine at once and marvels that anyone survived exploring the company's contested operations in the Barrens.

faq.answer: Rilli Greasygob is a goblin engineer at Nogg's Machine Shop in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. He once worked for the Venture Company and knows its technology firsthand, including devices like the samophlange.

faq.q: Why couldn't Wenikee Boltbucket fix the samophlange herself?
faq.answer: Wenikee Boltbucket's extra gauges showed that the samophlange was close to coming apart. She feared further tinkering would ruin it and sought someone with direct experience of Venture Company machinery.
Rilli Greasygob works inside Nogg's Machine Shop in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, in the city's northeastern district.

faq.q: What is the Venture Company's role in this?
faq.answer: The samophlange came from the Venture Company's strip-mining operation at the Sludge Fen in the northern Barrens. It is custom company technology, and former workers like Rilli Greasygob know how to service and interpret it.

faq.q: What happens after giving the samophlange to Rilli?
faq.answer: Rilli Greasygob recognizes the device but needs the Venture Company's official operational instructions to operate or reconstruct it. You are sent to recover the Samophlange Manual.

No one involved seems quite sure what a samophlange is. The Venture Company device is intricate and full of gears; even Wenikee Boltbucket had to ask what it was, and Rilli needs the company's manual to understand it.

angles.text: As an engineer, you know when to set down the wrench. Wenikee Boltbucket's extra dials would only worsen matters, so she turns to the trade knowledge of a former company engineer.
As a member of the Horde, you can see how Orgrimmar's workshops put captured machinery to use against syndicates exploiting Kalimdor.
